models.description: Main user table with email/password authentication credentials and profile information

plainFields.description: Hashed password for authentication. Never stores plain text passwords.
plainFields.name: password_hash

plainFields.description: User's display name shown in the application interface.
plainFields.name: display_name

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.
plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated.
plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.description: JWT session tokens with access and refresh token support for user authentication

foreignFields.description: Reference to the user who owns this session. {@link todo_app_users.id}.
foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id

models.name: todo_app_user_sessions

plainFields.description: Unique session identifier (UUID) for the session token.
plainFields.name: session_id

plainFields.description: JWT refresh token for obtaining new access tokens. Used for token rotation and extended sessions.

models.description: Password reset tokens for user account recovery. Each token is valid for a single use and expires after a set period. Linked to users table for authentication flow.

models.name: todo_app_user_password_resets

plainFields.description: Password reset token generated for authentication. Used in password reset URL.
plainFields.name: token

plainFields.description: Timestamp when this password reset request was created.
plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.description: Timestamp when this password reset token expires. After this time, the token becomes invalid.
plainFields.name: expired_at

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was consumed (password successfully changed).
plainFields.name: consumed_at

plainFields.description: Timestamp when this password reset record was permanently deleted.

models.name: todo_app_system_audits
models.description: System audit log entries for tracking important system events such as authentication attempts, security events, and configuration changes. This table provides comprehensive audit trails for security monitoring and compliance requirements.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: User who triggered the audit event. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Category of the audit event (login, logout, password_change, security_alert, system_config_change, etc.).

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: IP address from which the event originated.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: Browser or client user agent string.

plainFields.name: event_metadata
plainFields.description: Additional event details in JSON format (e.g., login success/failure reason, config changes details).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the audit event occurred.

models.name: todo_app_system_settings
models.description: System configuration settings and parameters for application-wide configuration management.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Unique configuration key identifier (e.g., 'app.name', 'features.enabled').

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Configuration value stored as string for flexibility (supports JSON for complex values).

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable description of what this configuration setting controls.

plainFields.name: is_json
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether the value field contains JSON-formatted data.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration was last updated.

models.name: todo_app_todos
models.description: Main todo item records with title, description, dates, and completion status. Each todo belongs to exactly one user (todo_app_users) and can have zero or one associated edit history records and trash entries. Supports the complete Todo lifecycle from creation through editing, completion, soft deletion, and permanent deletion.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: Owner user's {@link todo_app_users.id}. The user who created and owns this todo item.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was soft-deleted. Nullable indicates active todo.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title of the todo item. Required field, cannot be empty.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the todo item. Optional field, can be empty.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Optional start date for the todo item. Indicates when work on this task should begin.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional due date for the todo item. Indicates when this task should be completed.

plainFields.name: is_completed
plainFields.description: Completion status flag. True indicates the todo is completed, false indicates active/incomplete.

models.name: todo_app_todo_edit_histories
models.description:
Edit history entries tracking all changes made to todo items. Captures the state of todo fields (title, description, start_date, due_date) at the time of each edit, allowing reconstruction of todo item evolution over time.

This is a subsidiary entity managed through parent todo items. Each edit creates a history entry that permanently records the previous values before the change, supporting complete audit trails for todo item modifications.

plainFields.name: title_before
plainFields.description: Todo title value before the edit.

plainFields.name: description_before
plainFields.description: Todo description value before the edit.

plainFields.name: start_date_before
plainFields.description: Todo start date value before the edit.

plainFields.name: due_date_before
plainFields.description: Todo due date value before the edit.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp of this history entry.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp of this history entry.

models.description:
Trash management records for soft-deleted todo items with restoration capability.

This table captures the state of todo items when they are soft-deleted by users. It maintains
a complete snapshot of the todo at the time of deletion, allowing for restoration if needed
before permanent deletion occurs. The table tracks which user performed the deletion and
provides audit trail through system audit references.

Key features:
- Stores todo state at time of soft deletion
- Enables todo restoration to active state
- Supports permanent deletion workflow
- Maintains audit trail of deletion events
- Links to user and session for accountability

foreignFields.description: Reference to the soft-deleted todo item {@link todo_app_todos.id}.
foreignFields.name: todo_id

foreignFields.description: User who performed the soft delete {@link todo_app_users.id}.
foreignFields.name: user_id

foreignFields.description: System audit reference for deletion event {@link todo_app_system_audits.id}.
foreignFields.name: system_audit_id

models.name: todo_app_todo_trashes

plainFields.description: Todo title at time of deletion.
plainFields.name: title

plainFields.description: Todo description at time of deletion.
plainFields.name: description

plainFields.description: Todo start date at time of deletion (nullable if not set).
plainFields.name: start_date

plainFields.description: Todo due date at time of deletion (nullable if not set).
plainFields.name: due_date

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was soft-deleted to trash.
plainFields.name: deleted_at
